prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Rhodium (Rh) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace
Time of day: night — the scene lit by lamps, screens or windows, dark outside.
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Outfit: a modern toga mini dress — one-shoulder draped jersey in a short wrap, a gold cuff on the upper arm and strappy sandals — in bright sunflower yellow; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 40-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 25-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera low, near the ground, level with her face as she sits or kneels; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small glass jar of rose-red rhodium salt crystals beside a mirror-bright white ring up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes, mouth firmly closed.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — rhodium: a hard, brilliant silver-white metal that never tarnishes, found in 1804 in the residue of platinum ore after palladium had been drawn out, and named from the Greek for rose because its salts are rose-red; plated over white gold, mirrors and searchlight reflectors it gives the whitest, most lasting shine; one of the rarest precious metals, it has at times cost more than ten times as much as gold, the most expensive metal of all; most of it works unseen inside car catalytic converters, turning the nitrogen oxides of exhaust back into clean nitrogen — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

Reference face, eye colour and skin tone recognizable; reference used for generation.
Visible arms and hands attach naturally; no obvious extra or detached limb.
